scope: CPU/read-only historical process audit; writes harness.* only; no GPU/SSH/API/queue/git mutations
finding: All five requested failures are harness/instrumentation defects, not established candidate numeric kernel failures. This selected sample is not a population failure-rate estimate.
timing_limits: Result start/finish and external host timestamp spans are different accounting scopes; do not sum or call them GPU busy time. CPU budgets in reviews are estimates, not measured CPU usage.

cases.cause: Harness classified every RQ TU as containing four M128 EH/control targets; actual small TU correctly has none.
cases.CPU_review_blind_spot: 95/99 SASS/resource checks, eleven CPU tests and independent review missed actual small/large module partition.

cases.cause: Harness required Runtime user static shared=1024, conflating dump SHARED/system reservation. Exact failed flag/value was not persisted and remains unknown.
cases.CPU_review_blind_spot: 123-pin independent wrapper review, fake complete mechanism run and physical/resource tests accepted the incorrect expected value.

cases.cause: Same static-shared conflation: actual T8/DIV8 runtime static_shared0, registers32, local0, maxThreads256, maxDynamic49152, occupancy8.
cases.CPU_review_blind_spot: 82-input screen, eleven CPU tests, 4064 normative bit cases, eight full production stream/physical checks and review still encoded static1024.

cases.cause: CPU user_annotation and gpu_user_annotation legitimately share replay names; parser failed to filter category and rejected duplicate scopes.
cases.CPU_review_blind_spot: 136 dependency pins, twelve author parser negatives and six independent parser/counter negatives omitted this genuine trace category collision.

cases.cause: Production prepare removes gvc12; fixed mechanism required it after prepare. Immutable revision2 would always abort at fixed stage.
cases.CPU_review_blind_spot: 203 closure pins, offline15+8 exact device streams, scalar/chain/source proofs and fake terminal/counter negatives do not model prepared-state lifetime. Independent source-flow review caught it before driver GO.

recommendations.early: One candidate/control source+build recipe digest, exact measured symbol and shape. Reuse validated unchanged binary by SO hash/compiler/flags/architecture.
recommendations.defer_or_remove: No unconditional re-review/redump of every unrelated old main or transitive history file for each screen.
recommendations.final: Validate newly built/touched/served functions; full closure and independent final result review before promotion.

recommendations.early: One launch helper shared across experiments; persist raw actual fields before assertions. Check actual requested threads/dynamic bytes, capacity, launch success and nonzero occupancy for measured functions. Keep user static and driver reservation typed separately.
recommendations.defer_or_remove: Remove dump SHARED==Runtime sharedSizeBytes assertion. Resource maxima alone do not justify rejection without correctness/safety/performance purpose.
recommendations.final: Reconcile full served scope; exact resource matching only when claiming binary identity or matched resources.

recommendations.early: Small real-shape/module/state fixture: actual TU dispatch subset, completed prepare cache lifetime, real trace categories. Prefer one bounded GPU smoke after minimal source safety review over more self-consistent fake mocks.
recommendations.defer_or_remove: Stop treating test/pin counts as integration evidence; do not duplicate fake models that copy expected constants.
recommendations.final: Reusable regression fixtures for observed failure classes.

recommendations.early: Independent normal/outlier/zero plus discriminating current-X/boundary/changed-index probes for each measured path; terminal output before any further replay; poison outputs; active counter/immutability checks.
recommendations.defer_or_remove: Defer repeated allK for every arm/geometry and all30 policy/full-task campaigns until measured mechanism warrants integration; reuse unchanged mapping proofs. No arbitrary gain threshold.
recommendations.final: Complete task/shape/basis coverage where needed for changed mapping, strict numerics, mutation/counter/drain checks and current-incumbent whole-policy comparison before promotion.

recommendations.early: Finite event timing, same fixtures, simple balanced AB/BA and both signed outcomes. Selected launch identity from existing dispatch/node metadata.
recommendations.defer_or_remove: Profiler/Chrome/NCU as optional diagnostics; parser failures invalidate attribution, not already valid numerical outputs. Separate setup smoke from expensive prepare/fullpolicy.
recommendations.final: All30 package/selection checks and separate official evaluation when required; retain tiny/conflicting estimates.
